policy: This registry records compiler status only. The checker compiles every active root and then runs lake build DavisKahan.Experimental, so omitted failures cannot be certified by an empty registry.

roots.reason: Section 8 source surface. Nothing is wrong with its own source; SelectedBranch and SourceSurface import DavisKahan.Experimental.InfiniteDimensional, and four modules on that path have never produced an olean: Core.CompatibilitySinTwoTheta, Ideals.Symmetric, GraphSubspace, and Sylvester.Resolvent. Resolvent is on the critical path via Sylvester.Basic and calls a Contour.integral / Contour.IsClosed / Contour.Rectifiable API that exists nowhere in this repository, in Mathlib, or in vendored Spectra, so the other three unblock nothing. Parked until that API is written; promote back to DavisKahan/Sources/DavisKahan1970 once it compiles.
